scope: Proposition 9.8 (The compact localized intersection) of the manuscript “Finite generation for the K(n)-local sphere” (preprints/Finite-generation-for-the-Kn-local-sphere-September-24-2026/Finite-generation-for-the-Kn-local-sphere-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 313 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 07b43c6077268638), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 78. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix i ≥ 0 and N ≥ 1. Suppose SN Xi/SN+1 Xi is countable. (9.17) Then SN Mi/SN+1Mi is finite, and (SN Mi)/Ii is a finitely generated k[[z]]-module with z = S. The operator S on SN Xi has countable kernel and cokernel. Moreover ker(fi|SN Mi ) is finite and closed, fi is injective on Ii, and ⋂ a≥0 im(Sa Mi −→ Xi) = fi(Ii) ∼ = Ii. (9.18) In particular the intersection is finite. No topology on Xi and no closed-image assertion for its cochain differential is required.
